newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA FIRST FOOD SEES PRO-FORMA EPS AT 18.3 CTS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA FIRST FOOD SEES PRO-FORMA EPS AT 18.3 CTS.

text.p: South Africa's First SA Food Holdings, which plans to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in June, said on Wednesday it expected pro-forma attributable income of 18.6 million rand in the year ended June 1997.
It was also aiming for earnings per share of 18.3 cents.

First Foods, which is a unit of First South Africa Holdings (FSAH), a sibling of Nasdaq listed First SA Corp , said attributable income for 1998 was forecast to rise 57.4 percent to 29.3 million rand and earnings per share of 23.4 cents.
First Food invests in niched food manufacturing operations and owns four operating companies, namely Piemans Pantry, Astoria Bakery, Seemann's Quality Meat Products and Gull Food.
A total of 125 million shares will be issued, with FSAH directly retaining 70 percent, management and employees 10 percent and the public the remaining 20 percent.
